eventClusters.statement: Memory moved from prolonged decline into an industry-wide pricing rebound in Q4 2023 as supplier production cuts combined with handset/server restocking; mobile DRAM/NAND price increases accelerated materially.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Physical evidence is strong but concentrated in one specialist origin; company-level realized conversion is mandatory.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share memory exposure had a direct realized/quantitative earnings bridge from the Q4 price reversal rather than inventory speculation?

eventClusters.statement: AI infrastructure demand remained structurally strong into Q4 2023: NVIDIA data-center revenue accelerated sharply and TrendForce expected 2024 AI-server growth to remain high, while China-specific restrictions created heterogeneous exposure.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Global demand is strong, but China GPU restrictions mean generic domestic AI exposure may not convert. Deep research must isolate companies with realized export/global-customer engines.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share AI infrastructure supplier had already converted global AI capex into revenue/profit and retained expectation room?

eventClusters.statement: China tightened export licensing for high-sensitivity natural/artificial graphite from Dec 1, creating policy scarcity optionality but without pre-cutoff evidence that licences were broadly denied or that listed-company earnings improved.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Policy was real, but MOFCOM itself said applications had not yet been received before implementation; physical/earnings incidence is unresolved.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any realized company earnings bridge, or is this only policy optionality?

eventClusters.statement: Mid-December Red Sea security incidents caused major carriers to suspend/reroute services, increasing sailing distance and tightening effective container capacity, but the shock was very new and its persistence was uncertain by quarter-end.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Single first-party origin at discovery and only two weeks of history before cutoff; persistence and rate pass-through must be independently verified before stock selection.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did the disruption create a measurable, durable freight-rate earnings bridge for any A-share carrier by Dec 31?

eventClusters.statement: China manufacturing demand weakened through Q4 while producer deflation persisted, creating a negative broad-demand backdrop even as selected technology cycles improved.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Useful as a regime/contradiction filter but not a narrow long beneficiary.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as context rather than standalone stock-selection thesis.
